title: 2027 Audi Q8 Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: Essentially a Q7 with a sloped roofline and less cargo space, the five-passenger Audi Q8 crossover SUV gets a sportier look for 2027, along with new alloy wheel options.
body_markdown:
The Audi Q8 is a stylized version of the Q7 midsize luxury SUV with more of a coupe-like profile. It takes on the BMW X6 and the Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe.

## What’s New for the 2027 Audi Q8


The Audi Q8 last received a major update for 2024. For 2027, it gets the S line exterior trim as standard and comes with a new 21-inch wheel design. There is also a new optional 22-inch, 10-spoke Y-design wheel with a matte neodymium gold finish, available with the Black Optic package.


## Design


The Audi Q8 looks sleeker than most SUVs. The biggest difference between it and the Q7 upon which it is based is a fast rear roofline that saps some cargo space. The nose features a wide version of the brand’s trapezoidal singleframe grille with large open mesh. It combines with the standard matrix LED headlights in a mask-like design, below which sit pronounced air intakes pushed to the corners within gray surrounds. The rear has a roof spoiler, a full-width LED taillight, and more gray trim. The Prestige trim upgrades to OLED taillights and is offered with LED laser high beams. The S Line elements of the design consist of more aggressive front and rear bumpers and side sills than the base versions in previous model years. A Black Optic package comes with black exterior trim, while a Carbon package adds carbon-fiber mirror housings, carbon-fiber side sill inserts, and a carbon-fiber insert between the taillights. Large 21-inch alloy wheels make the Q8 look grounded, and buyers can go for a sportier look with 22s and 23s.


## Powertrain


The Q8 draws its power from a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 that produces 335 horsepower and 369 pound-feet of torque. Power flows through an eight-speed automatic transmission to all four wheels via Audi’s quattro all-wheel-drive (AWD) system. The EPA rates the Q8 at 17 mpg city, 23 mpg highway, and 19 mpg combined. The Q8 can tow up to 7,700 pounds. While the Q8 has AWD, it’s for all-weather traction, not off-roading. Audi offers no off-road packages for the Q8.


## Interior


The 2027 Audi Q8 seats five in two rows. It comes standard with leather upholstery, power-adjustable and heated front seats, tri-zone automatic climate control, and a panoramic sunroof. One rung up the trim ladder, the Q8 adds ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, four-zone automatic climate control, and ambient lighting. The top Prestige gets a combination of Valcona and Cricket leather upholstery, more front seat power adjustments, and massaging front seats. Extended Nappa leather upholstery is optional and covers the dashboard as well as the seats. A Sport Plus package has front sport seats upholstered in Valcona leather. The Q8’s design offers less cargo space than the Q7's, but still provides useful space. It has 33.7 cubic feet behind the second row and 60.7 cubic feet behind the first row with the second row folded flat.


## Technology


The Q8 features a three-screen setup that is now old for the brand. It includes a 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster, a 10.1-inch infotainment touchscreen, and an 8.6-inch touchscreen for climate controls. Also standard are wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, as well as satellite radio. Moving up one trim level brings a Bang & Olufsen audio system, and the Prestige trim adds a head-up display.

## Safety


Standard safety features on the 2027 Audi Q8 include forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control, automatic parking, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, lane-keep assist, and rear parking sensors. A surround-view camera system is standard on all but the base trim, and the Prestige gets remote parking. Also available are high-beam assist and night vision. The Q8 received a five-out-of-five-star overall rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety gave it its best Good scores in the small front overlap and updated side crash tests, and a Marginal rating in the updated moderate front overlap test. The base headlights were rated Acceptable and the upgraded lights were rated Good. The front crash-prevention system received a Poor rating for its vehicle-to-vehicle evaluation and Acceptable for its pedestrian evaluation.


## Pricing and Release Date


Audi offers the Q8 in Premium, Premium Plus, and Prestige trim levels. At the time of writing, the Premium started at $78,295, including a $1,395 destination fee. The Premium Plus increases the price to $83,495, and the Prestige costs $88,895. In addition to the features mentioned above, the Q8 comes standard with adaptive dampers. A Sport Plus package adds a sport-tuned air suspension, sport seats, and red brake calipers, among several other trim features.
